en.headline: Hospital Authority says 23 people hospitalised after Northern Metropolis Marathon
en.dek: The Authority reported the figure as of 3:10pm on Sunday for the inaugural event that drew about 15,000 runners.
body: The Hospital Authority said 23 people had been admitted to hospital after injuries sustained at the first Northern Metropolis Marathon, as of 3:10pm on Sunday.

The race, organised by the Heung Yee Kuk New Territories, started in the early morning with about 15,000 participants across full marathon, half marathon, 10km and shorter events. Full marathon runners began at 6:30am from the Heung Yee Kuk building in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, finishing on the Fanling Bypass.

Organisers and runners noted challenging conditions including heat around 25 to 28 degrees Celsius and sections of the route with slopes and shared paths. The Heung Yee Kuk said it would consider holding future editions in cooler months.

zh.headline: 醫管局稱北都馬拉松至少23人受傷入院
zh.dek: 醫管局表示截至周日下午3時10分，有23人因賽事受傷入院治理，是次活動約有1.5萬人參與。
body: 醫院管理局表示，截至周日下午3時10分，首屆北部都會區馬拉松有23人因傷入院治理。
賽事由新界鄉議局主辦，清晨開跑，約1.5萬人參加全馬、半馬、10公里及其他項目。全馬賽事早上6時半在沙田石門新界鄉議局大樓起步，終點設於粉嶺繞道。
主辦單位及跑手指當日天氣約25至28度，部分路段有上落斜及共享徑，增加挑戰。鄉議局表示會考慮日後在較清涼月份再辦。
